statistical_method.continuous: paired within-seed differences, exact two-sided sign-flip randomization, 95% t confidence interval, Cohen dz and Hedges gz
statistical_method.binary: paired exact McNemar binomial test and Wilson 95% interval
statistical_method.multiple_testing: Holm step-down within efficacy and resource/cost families across scenes and E-vs-B/Bprime comparisons
statistical_method.latency: conditional sample set per strategy; no paired inference
statistical_method.failed_recovery: retained as failure; recovery-or-censoring uses configured duration for the paired continuous analysis
